messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Pediatric Dose for Generalized Anxiety Disorder:
7 to 17 years: -Initial dose: 30 mg orally once a day for at least 2 weeks -Maintenance dose: 30 to 60 mg orally once a day -Maximum dose: 120 mg/day.
Usual Pediatric Dose for Fibromyalgia:
13 years and older: -Initial dose: 30 mg orally once a day for at least 1 week -Maintenance dose: 30 to 60 mg orally once a day.
Triplet: ["Duloxetine", "has maintenance dose", "30 to 60 mg orally once a day"]

The relation 'has maintenance dose' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is administered at the dose range specified by the object entity for ongoing treatment after an initial phase.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
B. 'has indication for initial dose': The subject drug's initial dose is indicated for the specified medical purpose or condition.
C. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
